labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is unknown for all window intervals.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires observed effort or aerobic-activity context; non-applicable if effort unrecorded.
labels.rationale: No intensity data available to apply the talk test.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Low movement minutes ~450/day with ~55 activity minutes in both periods.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires sitting posture and known activity intensity; low-movement estimates do not prove sitting.
labels.rationale: Device low movement is not confirmed sitting, so required conditions are unmet.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 346 min (~5.8h), stable across 14 days (variance 42).
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when sleep is consistently short even without a new decline.
labels.rationale: Directly explains that a stable short sleep routine does not prove adaptation.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Age band is 18-60.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Non-applicable for adults; requires teenage age group.
labels.rationale: Subject is an adult, not a teenager.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep start times recorded but no pre-bed activity information available.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires information about pre-bed activities; timestamps alone insufficient.
labels.rationale: No data on what the person did before bedtime.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 346 min, well below 7 hours; age band 18-60.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies to adults 18-60 with sleep duration below recommendation.
labels.rationale: Core reference: window sleep is persistently below the 7-hour adult recommendation.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Nighttime coverage >=355 min every window night; no missing sleep readings.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when sleep readings are absent with non-wear or incomplete coverage.
labels.rationale: All nights have adequate coverage and valid sleep records.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 346 min; individual experience unknown.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires individual sleep experience to assess adequacy.
labels.rationale: Contextual reminder that duration targets vary individually, though no subjective data here.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Weekday window sleep mean 344.3 min vs weekend 351.0 min; difference ~7 min.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Non-applicable when weekday and weekend sleep times are similar.
labels.rationale: Weekday/weekend sleep durations are very similar in the window.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No commuting or transport context recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires sedentary commuting to be established; commute unknown is non-applicable.
labels.rationale: No commute data available.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Only sleep duration, start, and end timestamps are recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Non-applicable when only duration and sleep start/end are available.
labels.rationale: No awakening data recorded in the wearable observations.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All vitals present with valid counts equaling period lengths; no missing data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when vitals are missing or delayed.
labels.rationale: No missing vitals to explain.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps ~8000/day and activity ~55 min/day in both periods.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies broadly to distinguish everyday movement from formal exercise.
labels.rationale: General context that recorded activity includes everyday movement, not just exercise.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No travel history recorded; timezone constant Asia/Shanghai.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires confirmed travel across time zones; non-applicable without travel history.
labels.rationale: No evidence of travel to apply jet lag guidance.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is unknown for all recorded intervals.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Non-applicable when only steps or unspecified active minutes are available.
labels.rationale: Cannot determine if moderate-intensity target is met without intensity data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 346 min, well under 8 hours; no refreshment reports.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires more than eight hours of sleep with reported lack of refreshment.
labels.rationale: Sleep is short, not long, and no subjective refreshment data exist.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep duration estimated by device; sleep boundaries also recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when device-estimated sleep duration and boundaries are available.
labels.rationale: Clarifies that recorded sleep duration is an estimate, not total time in bed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No workplace or meeting information recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires workplace and mobility context; non-applicable without it.
labels.rationale: No work context available to apply standing meeting advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Only sleep duration and timing are recorded; no sleep-stage data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Non-applicable when only sleep duration and timing are available.
labels.rationale: No sleep-stage measurements to review patterns over time.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Nighttime coverage >=355 min every window night; all overnight vitals present.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when overnight vitals have missing readings or uncertain coverage.
labels.rationale: No missing overnight vitals or coverage issues observed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 346 min across 14 consecutive nights, ~118 min below baseline.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when several nights of reduced sleep duration are observed.
labels.rationale: Core explanation: repeated short nights can affect performance even if subjectively tolerated.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Only 14-day wearable window; no reported sleeping difficulties or symptom history.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires months-long difficulties or reported insomnia symptoms; brief record alone insufficient.
labels.rationale: Two-week data without reported symptoms cannot establish insomnia warranting GP review.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps changed minimally between periods (mean difference +54); activity type unknown.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when steps change while other activity may differ.
labels.rationale: No meaningful step change to interpret; activity types unknown.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No substance, medication, or caffeine records available.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires substance and medication history for causal interpretation.
labels.rationale: Cannot attribute sleep changes without substance/medication context.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift work schedule confirmed.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires confirmed shift work; non-applicable without it.
labels.rationale: No evidence of shift work to apply bright lighting advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 14 consecutive window nights averaging 346 min, ~118 min below baseline mean.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when several shortened nights rather than a single isolated reading.
labels.rationale: Core explanation: repeated short sleep accumulates as sleep debt over time.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intervals at 21:00 daily with unknown intensity; sleep starts after midnight.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires known intensity relative to bedtime; non-applicable if intensity unknown.
labels.rationale: Activity intensity is unknown, so cannot determine if late exercise is intense.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR mean 55.4 bpm and HRV RMSSD mean 44.9 ms in window.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when HRV and heart-rate estimates are interpreted together.
labels.rationale: Clarifies that RHR and HRV are distinct metrics, both present in the data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 346 min across 14 nights, well below recommended duration.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when repeated insufficient sleep is observed.
labels.rationale: Supported connection: chronic short sleep can affect appetite hormones, though no intake data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Low movement intervals ~45 min each during daytime; posture not measured.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires mobility and posture context; low movement due to non-wear/sleep excluded.
labels.rationale: Device low movement is not confirmed sitting; posture context missing.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Age band is 18-60, not 61-64.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Non-applicable for age groups other than 61-64.
labels.rationale: Subject age band does not match this recommendation's population.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity duration stable ~55 min/day; no recent inactivity observed.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when recently low or reduced physical activity is observed.
labels.rationale: No evidence of recent inactivity requiring gradual buildup.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR recorded daily across 28 baseline and 14 window days.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when repeated resting heart-rate readings are available.
labels.rationale: Supports reviewing RHR trends over the full observation period rather than single values.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity duration ~55 min/day; intensity unknown.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires known intensity for counting guideline minutes.
labels.rationale: Cannot apply chunking advice without knowing activity intensity.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No nap information recorded in the wearable data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires recorded naps; non-applicable without nap information.
labels.rationale: No nap data available to evaluate compensation for short night sleep.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All vitals present; nighttime coverage >=355 min every window night.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when a vital is missing with limited night-time data.
labels.rationale: No missing vitals; all nights exceed minimum coverage thresholds.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No emergency-response deployment context recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires confirmed emergency-response deployment context.
labels.rationale: Not applicable; subject is not identified as a deployed emergency responder.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No chronic health conditions or special needs recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires relevant health condition and activity safety history.
labels.rationale: No medical context available to modify activity planning.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 14-day window only; no symptom history or reported sleeping difficulties.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires symptom history and onset; 14 days of estimates insufficient.
labels.rationale: Cannot categorize insomnia duration from wearable sleep estimates alone.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 346 min, ~118 min shorter than baseline 465 min.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when repeatedly shortened sleep opportunity or duration is observed.
labels.rationale: Supported connection: shortened sleep may reflect schedule constraints, though cause unknown.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No social preferences or motivational barriers recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires social preferences or reported motivational barrier.
labels.rationale: No evidence of social or motivational context for activity.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep start variance low in both periods; wake time fixed at 07:00 daily.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Non-applicable when a stable schedule alone does not establish a problem.
labels.rationale: Wake time is perfectly consistent; sleep start is stable within each period.

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV RMSSD recorded nightly; window sleep durations 335-355 min.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when overnight HRV estimates are compared; requires compatible device.
labels.rationale: Window sleep exceeds 3h threshold, supporting valid HRV collection per device rules.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No leisure context or seated habits recorded beyond low movement intervals.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires routine, preferences, and mobility context.
labels.rationale: Insufficient context about seated leisure to apply replacement advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No reported health concerns or symptoms in the data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires reported health concerns or symptoms.
labels.rationale: No clinical concerns raised to warrant provider referral based on these data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Daytime low movement intervals present; no workday lunch-break context recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires workday lunch-break access and mobility context.
labels.rationale: Unknown whether subject has a workday or lunch break opportunity.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No caffeine timing or intake records available.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires caffeine timing and intake; non-applicable without caffeine history.
labels.rationale: No caffeine data to link to sleep timing changes.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No pre-bed routine or relaxation difficulty reported.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires reported difficulty relaxing or request for routine options.
labels.rationale: No subjective data about bedtime routine or relaxation needs.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity duration stable ~55 min/day; no personal preferences recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires personal preferences and availability for choosing options.
labels.rationale: No preference or availability data to individualize activity choices.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Only steps and generic activity minutes recorded; no strengthening data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires strengthening activity records including days and muscle groups.
labels.rationale: Step counts cannot verify muscle-strengthening guideline compliance.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No workplace layout or desk work context recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires workplace layout and ability to walk.
labels.rationale: No work context available to apply colleague-walking suggestion.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No alcohol intake or timing records available.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires alcohol intake and timing; non-applicable when exposure unknown.
labels.rationale: No drinking history to evaluate pre-bed alcohol effects.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No reported sleepiness or driving context recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires sleepiness and driving plans; non-applicable when unknown.
labels.rationale: No subjective sleepiness or driving data available.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps stable across periods; no wear context changes noted.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires wear context and activity type changes affecting steps.
labels.rationale: No evidence of measurement limitations affecting step counts.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intervals at 21:00 daily; sleep starts after midnight in window.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires activity intervals for timing comparisons with subsequent sleep.
labels.rationale: Supports recording exercise timing alongside sleep timing for temporal context.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift work confirmed; sleep occurs overnight ending at 07:00.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires shift work and daytime sleep confirmation.
labels.rationale: No evidence of shift work or daytime sleep to apply this advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Single synthetic device used throughout; no device switch recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires device and algorithm change history.
labels.rationale: Same device used across baseline and window; no cross-device comparison issue.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 346 min across 14 consecutive nights.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when repeatedly shortened sleep is observed; symptoms needed for impairment claims.
labels.rationale: Supported connection: chronic short sleep relates to learning/attention, but no cognitive data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity at 21:00 daily; no reported insomnia symptoms.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires exercise near bedtime with reported insomnia symptoms.
labels.rationale: No insomnia symptom history to trigger the 4-hour pre-bed exercise restriction.

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV recorded as hrv_rmssd_ms in the dataset.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when HRV records identify RMSSD as their metric.
labels.rationale: Confirms the HRV metric definition used in the wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR stable 55-56 bpm in window; no exposure or symptom data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires exposure or symptom information to attribute a cause for RHR changes.
labels.rationale: RHR is stable and no contextual factors are recorded to explain changes.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity ~55 min/day and sleep recorded in both periods.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when activity and sleep patterns are available for joint review.
labels.rationale: General supported connection: activity benefits sleep, but causation cannot be claimed here.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No reported competing demands or schedule constraints recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires schedule constraints to apply calendar planning advice.
labels.rationale: No evidence that schedule demands are reducing activity.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity duration stable ~55 min/day; no declining routine movement observed.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires low or declining routine movement.
labels.rationale: No activity decline to address with routine walking suggestions.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Low movement ~450 min/day; posture not confirmed as sitting.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires confirmed sitting for specific sedentary-time conclusion.
labels.rationale: Device low movement is not confirmed sitting; cannot apply sedentary reduction advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No television-viewing or screen habit context recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires television-viewing context; non-applicable when screen habits unknown.
labels.rationale: No screen behavior data to apply TV break movement advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep start shifted later in window; no awakenings or naps recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires awakenings and naps to need separate records.
labels.rationale: Wearable data lacks awakenings and naps needed for a complete sleep diary timeline.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No meal timing or size records available.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires meal timing and size; non-applicable when meal information unknown.
labels.rationale: No dietary data to evaluate heavy meals near bedtime.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Wake time is exactly 07:00 every day; no reported sleeping difficulties.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires inconsistent wake time with reported sleeping difficulties.
labels.rationale: Wake time is perfectly consistent; no insomnia symptoms reported.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep duration recorded; no awakenings, onset difficulty, or refreshment data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires sleep-onset difficulty, awakenings, or subjective refreshment to establish quality concern.
labels.rationale: Duration alone cannot establish sleep quality; important distinction for interpreting short sleep.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No screen or light exposure information recorded before bed.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires screen or light exposure information; non-applicable when unknown.
labels.rationale: No data on pre-bed screen use to attribute sleep timing changes.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No stair access or mobility context recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires stair access and safe mobility context.
labels.rationale: No environmental data to apply stair-use suggestion.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No travel or trip context recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires trip duration and time-zone change; non-applicable when travel unknown.
labels.rationale: No evidence of any trip to apply short-trip sleep scheduling advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 28 baseline days and 14 window days of vitals available for trend comparison.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires sufficient same-metric personal history.
labels.rationale: Supports using the 28-day baseline as personal range context for window changes.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Weekend window sleep mean 351 min vs weekday 344.3 min; difference ~7 min.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires actual workdays and days off; assumes longer sleep on days off.
labels.rationale: Minimal weekend/weekday difference; no evidence of compensatory longer sleep on days off.

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV RMSSD recorded nightly across both periods.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when an HRV trend is available for wellness monitoring.
labels.rationale: Important context: HRV trends are wellness observations, not diagnostic indicators.

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV RMSSD mean 44.8 baseline, 44.9 window; stable across periods.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when an HRV level or trend is being reviewed.
labels.rationale: Supports interpreting HRV within personal context rather than against universal norms.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity unknown; weekly moderate/vigorous totals unverifiable.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires known intensity and weekly duration; non-applicable when intensity unknown.
labels.rationale: Cannot assess additional aerobic benefits without intensity classification.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No nap duration or timing recorded in the data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires nap history; non-applicable when nap history is unknown.
labels.rationale: No nap data available to apply duration or timing recommendations.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Daily resting heart rate recorded; no sleeping heart rate series separated.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when a daily resting heart-rate trend is being interpreted.
labels.rationale: Clarifies that the recorded RHR differs from sleeping heart rate for proper interpretation.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No subjective energy pattern or tiredness reports recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires subjective energy pattern and availability; non-applicable without tiredness history.
labels.rationale: No energy or tiredness data to guide activity timing choices.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity ~55 min/day; intensity unknown.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires intensity information to count recommended aerobic minutes.
labels.rationale: Cannot equate recorded activity minutes with guideline compliance without intensity data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No bedroom light, noise, or temperature data recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires bedroom light, noise, or temperature context; non-applicable when unknown.
labels.rationale: No environmental data to evaluate bedroom sleep-supporting conditions.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No reported time barrier or daily schedule diary available.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires actual daily schedule and time barrier; non-applicable when assuming from low steps.
labels.rationale: No evidence of a time barrier to activity that would warrant diary tracking.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Age band is 18-60, not 65 or older.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Non-applicable for age below 65.
labels.rationale: Subject age band does not match the older adult recommendation.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Low movement intervals recorded without posture measurement.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires posture and waking context; non-applicable when treating low movement as confirmed sitting.
labels.rationale: Device low movement is not confirmed sitting; posture context is missing.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No outdoor access or exposure data recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires outdoor access and mobility for a specific plan.
labels.rationale: Cannot infer outdoor exposure from movement counts alone.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is unknown for all recorded intervals.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires known vigorous intensity; non-applicable when intensity unknown.
labels.rationale: Cannot apply vigorous activity target without intensity classification.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift work or caffeine use records available.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires shift schedule and caffeine intake; non-applicable when unknown.
labels.rationale: No shift work or caffeine data to apply this specific guidance.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No nicotine use or smoking history recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires nicotine exposure; non-applicable when nicotine use unknown.
labels.rationale: No nicotine data to link to sleep pattern changes.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift-work schedule confirmed; sleep timing stable within each period.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires confirmed shift-work schedule; non-applicable when shift work unknown.
labels.rationale: No evidence of rotating shifts to apply shift-change limitation advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity unknown; fitness level not recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires fitness or perceived effort context; non-applicable when inferring from steps alone.
labels.rationale: Cannot assign relative intensity without fitness or effort data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR stable across periods; no wear quality changes noted.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires device placement and contact information suggesting fit problems.
labels.rationale: No evidence of sensor fit issues affecting heart-rate accuracy.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No reported bad nights or insomnia symptoms; wake time fixed at 07:00.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires reported bad sleep or insomnia symptoms; non-applicable with only device estimates.
labels.rationale: No subjective sleeping difficulty to trigger post-bad-night regularity advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Daily RHR recorded across 42 days; values 55-57 bpm.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when resting heart rate observations are available.
labels.rationale: Clarifies that recorded RHR is measured while still and rested, distinct from exercise HR.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window sleep mean 346 min across 14 consecutive nights, substantially below baseline.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when ongoing insufficient sleep is observed.
labels.rationale: Supported connection: chronic short sleep relates to immune function, but no infection data.
